test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If a certain sum becomes two times itself in 6 years at compound interest in case of annual compounding, then the number of years in which it will become eight times of itself at the same rate of interest under annual compounding is:
solution:
Given:

Amount doubles under compound interest in 6 years.

Concept used:

Amount = Principal × [{1 +{ r over 100}}]^n

r = rate of interest

n = time in years

Calculation:

From the given data, we know that the amount doubles

Let us consider,

Amount = 2P

Principal = P

Substitute the values in the formula

2P = P × [{1 +{ r over 100}}]⁶

2 = [{1 +{ r over 100}}]⁶

We know that 2³ = 8

So, take the power as 3 on both the sides

2³ = [[{1 +{ r over 100}}]⁶]³

8 = [[{1 +{ r over 100}}]¹⁸] ----- (1)

Compare equation (1) with the formula

Time (n) = 18 years

∴ In 18 years the amount will become 8 times.
